title: English Conversation 25:  Dishwasher
content: 1. to be sick and tired of doing something: to be bored or annoyed of something that one has been doing for a long time - I am sick and tired of this job. I need to find a new job. - I have only eaten salad for the last 10 days because of my diet. I am sick and tired of eating salad. I want a hamburger. 2. Can a person afford...?: a question used to ask if there is enough money to do something - Can you afford to buy a new car? - Can you afford to buy that expensive jacket? 3. It costs...: a sentence pattern used to tell the price of something - It costs 10 dollars. - It costs $50.
